recipes.name: Meta-Harness
setup: Prepare Python >=3.12, pyproject.toml dependencies, a compatible Harbor installation and Terminal-Bench backend.
Configure ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or the selected model environment explicitly; no commercial inference is performed during planning.

profiles.description: Frozen Meta-Harness AgentHarness evaluated by the installed native Harbor command

evaluation.description: Frozen Meta-Harness AgentHarness evaluated by the installed native Harbor command Metrics and validity retain the native evaluator contract.

argument_help: -m MODEL -e BACKEND -n CONCURRENCY --n-attempts N, following the installed Harbor CLI.
limitations: Source and fixture checks only; dependencies, paid model calls and native end-to-end execution are not verified. Native metrics are not canonical Arena task receipts.
This repository publishes the discovered agent artifact, not the harness-optimization process.
Harbor is an external installed dependency; its entrypoint/version and result schema are not pinned by this source revision.
